answer: Every claim climbs the oasis of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the velvet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on time-locked work history, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the kernel of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
